title: Build a pull request quality gate reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for build a pull request quality gate should include: pull_request:, permissions:, steps:.
answer.example:
name: Required pull request checks
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "Run lint, tests, and build checks"
answer.verification: A pull request targeting `main` receives a single checks status; configure branch rules separately to require this exact status.
